rq: RQ4 — does domain randomization occur naturally in the OSM->CARLA pipeline?

determinism_arm.structure_signature_identical: num_roads=32920, num_junctions=3717, total_road_length=1498527.5916156755 identical across all runs
determinism_arm.finding: Osm2Odr(pinned OSM) is STRUCTURALLY deterministic (identical roads/junctions/length every run) but BYTE-non-deterministic (serialization ordering/IDs/metadata vary). Re-running yields the SAME map -> natural DR is ABSENT.

answer: Natural domain randomization does NOT occur: the pipeline reproduces the same map structure on every run; byte-level differences are non-semantic serialization noise, not randomization. Therefore the thesis's domain randomization must be EXPLICIT.

explicit_dr.mechanism: image-space augmentation (weather/lighting/texture) at capture time; seeded local RNGs (no global seeding).

reproducibility_nuance: Osm2Odr byte-non-determinism means exact-sha reproduction of the seed XODR (and possibly the final candidate) is NOT guaranteed -- only STRUCTURAL reproduction. Pinning-by-sha (C11) assumes byte-determinism; document that provenance guarantees structural, not byte-exact, reproduction across re-conversions.
multi_map_arm_note: generate_n_runs runs the FULL pipeline N times (~1.5h each). Since the pipeline is structurally deterministic, N runs on the same OSM re-confirm determinism (no natural spread). Distinct maps for a DR study require EXPLICIT parameter/seed variation, not natural randomization. Heavy n>=5 generation deferred as it does not change the RQ4 answer.
claim_boundary: Do NOT claim natural DR. Report: natural DR absent -> explicit DR (RealismAugmentor) applied.
